_comment: Hand-verified repairs keyed <version>/<SEG>-<index>, each with the citation it was verified against. Despite the file name it carries three columns: TBL# ("tables", required), RP/# ("repeatability", optional, P6-5) and LEN ("length", optional, P6-12). Loaded by scripts/audit-schemas.py, which skips keys starting with an underscore.

v2.3.1/NSC-1.cite: v2.3.1 Appendix C sec C.2.3 NSC attribute table row 1 (TBL# 0333, ITEM# 01188); the segment is depth-whitelisted (extraction noise), so its bindings are repairs-only

v2.3/DB1-2.cite: v2.3 CH3 sec 3.3.10 DB1 attribute table prints TBL# 0033 for Disabled person code: a digit transposition. The field definition (3.3.10.2) says 'Refer to user-defined table 0334 - Disabled person' and prints that table beneath it; Appendix A lists 0334 Disabled Person with the same four values and has no 0033; v2.3.1, v2.4 and v2.5.1 all print 0334. Registered spec typo, normalised (precedent: v2.4 AL1-1).

v2.5.1/TQ1-12.cite: v2.5.1 CH04 TQ1 attribute table prints TBL# 0427 (Risk Management Incident Code) for Conjunction; sec 4.5.4.12 says 'Refer To HL7 Table 0472 - TQ Conjunction ID' and prints that table (A, C, S) beneath it; v2.6 and v2.8.2 print 0472. Registered spec misprint, normalised (V251-C06).

v2.5.1/CON-18.cite: v2.5.1 CH09 CON attribute table prints TBL# 0296 (Primary Language); sec 9.9.4.18 says 'Refer to User-Defined Table 0545 - Language Translated To' and prints that table. Both recorded; 0545, the field's own table, is the enforced link (V251-C06).

v2.5.1/SID-4.cite: v2.5.1 CH13 SID attribute table prints TBL# 0385; the SID-4 definition says 'Refer to User-defined Table 0451 - Manufacturer identifier'. The stated name is 0385's (0451 is Substance identifier), so the prose number is the misprint and 0385 stands (V251-C06).

v2.5.1/RCP-7.cite: v2.5.1 CH05 RCP attribute table prints TBL# (and OPT) blank for Segment group inclusion; sec 5.5.6.7 says 'Refer to HL7 Table 0391-Segment group' and prints it (V251-C07).

v2.4/RCP-7.cite: v2.4 CH05 RCP attribute table prints TBL# (and OPT) blank for Segment group inclusion; sec 5.5.5.7 refers to HL7 Table 0391 and prints it (same defect as v2.5.1, V251-C07).

v2.5.1/SAC-28.cite: v2.5.1 CH13 SAC attribute table prints TBL# blank for Specimen Component; sec 13.4.3.28 says 'Refer to User-defined Table 0372 - Specimen component' and prints it (V251-C07).

v2.6/UAC-1.cite: v2.6 CH02 sec 2.14.13 UAC attribute table (p. 71): the LEN cell for User Authentication Credential Type Code is 705 (the CWE maximum used throughout v2.6), but pdftotext -layout renders it '7 05' and -raw '7 0 5', the middle glyph set off its baseline. TBL# 0615 as printed (P6-12)

v2.7.1/OBX-5.cite: v2.7.1 CH07 section 7.3.2 OBX attribute table (p. 46) prints TBL# blank for Observation Value, and Appendix A's data element index gives OBX-5 no table; the only 9999 is in the ANO category example table (p. 143), which is not the definition, and 9999 is the 'no table assigned' sentinel

v2.7.1/OBX-8.cite: The defining attribute table omits TBL#: v2.7.1 CH07 section 7.3.2 OBX attribute table (p. 46) prints TBL# blank for Interpretation Codes, and the 7.3.2.8 prose names no table. The 0078 binding rests on v2.7.1 CH02C section 2.C.2.15 (p. 25), whose metadata for User-defined Table 0078 - Interpretation Codes reads 'Where used: OBX-8', and on the CH07 observation category tables (pp. 141 to 143), which print 0078 for OBX-8 (as does the CH09 OBX usage table)
